Caro (AE): Heads up — TitanCorp just escalated: they want a contractual P95 latency SLO of 75ms for our hosted embeddings endpoint for their renewal. They said it's a dealbreaker unless we can promise it or give a path to it.
Alice (PM): Oof. Do we have telemetry that shows current P95 for their traffic pattern?
Diego (CS): Their prod traffic has big batch sizes and long sequences. For embeddings it's mostly 512 tokens. Current P95 across tenants is ~130ms for the standard embedding model. TitanCorp's volume is ~3x our median per-tenant.
Ben (Eng): 75ms is pretty tight. We can approach it two ways: (A) route them to Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) — fast, but requires contract and infra setup; (B) optimize hosting stack: tighter batching heuristics + KV prefix cache for their common prefixes + quantized model variant — engineering effort and risk.
Emma (VP Product): Prioritization call: this is a big logo, but we need to weigh against other roadmap bets. What's the RICE for a focused project to get hosted P95 to 75ms?
Alice (PM): Quick RICE sketch (ballpark): Reach = affects 1 large customer initially, potential 10 similar later (R=~10). Impact = high for renewal (I=8). Confidence = medium (C=60). Effort = 6 engineer-months across runtime + SRE (E=6). RICE score = (10*8*0.6)/6 ~ 8.0.
Ben (Eng): If we instead push them to Dedicated, engineering effort is ~2 weeks product onboarding + infra provisioning (E=0.5), Reach lower (R=1 initially), Impact still high for that customer (I=7), Confidence high (C=80). RICE = (1*7*0.8)/0.5 = 11.2 — looks better short-term.
Diego (CS): Dedicated is feasible but TitanCorp explicitly asked for hosted SLA; they want no change to endpoint URL. They said switching to Dedicated is undesirable from their ops perspective.
Caro (AE): They also sign our contract faster if we commit to hosted SLO. Renewal in 6 weeks.
Fiona (SRE): Operational risk: hosting-level 75ms P95 for that load might require capacity isolation or pre-warming. Without isolation, we could introduce noisy neighbor issues and increased costs. Also need alerting & billing changes for overage protection.
Alice (PM): Options for sequencing: 1) Short-term: temporary SLA carve-out + canary dedicated pool for TitanCorp while we work on hosted optimizations (deliverable in 2-3 weeks). 2) Mid-term: host optimizations (3-4 months) to hit 75ms multi-tenant. 3) Long-term: productize auto-isolation + QoS routing (6+ months).
Ben (Eng): Implementation plan for option 1: provision a small dedicated pool, route TitanCorp traffic via routing rule, expose same API hostname via a proxy that marks requests. Minimal runtime changes. Risk low.
Emma (VP Product): From a product perspective, option 1 + roadmap slot for mid-term host work seems reasonable. But we need guardrails so we don't build permanent dedicated workarounds for many customers. We should add launch criteria and rollback policy.
Alice (PM): Launch criteria (for the temporary SLA carve-out): 1) Dedicated canary sustains P95<=75ms under TitanCorp load in staging; 2) SRE runbook and alerts in place; 3) Legal checkbox: amendment signed; 4) Monitoring dashboards with token-level cost. Rollback: revert to multi-tenant endpoint and give 48h notice.
Caro (AE): TitanCorp legal is willing to sign an amendment if we provide clear timeline for hosted path and price protection. They want the hosted guarantee within 6 months.
Diego (CS): Customer success notes: we should include an evaluation plan — sample prompts, traffic patterns, and verifiable tests for the SLO. Otherwise later disputes happen.
Ben (Eng): Action items: 1) Eng infra spike to provision canary dedicated pool (Ben + Fiona) — ETA 10 business days. 2) PM to draft amendment template with legal (Alice). 3) CS to collect representative traffic and test cases (Diego). 4) Sales to negotiate timeline (Caro).
oncall-bot: Reminder — SRE oncall rotation updated, Fiona now oncall for infra this week.
Fiona (SRE): I'll take the infra spike. Will post a short RFC in #eng-runtime today with perf numbers and change list.
Emma (VP Product): Agree on sequencing and communicate to execs. Alice, ping me when amendment draft and eng spike plan are ready so we can brief CEO before Friday.
Alice (PM): Will do. I'll post the RICE calc and a one-pager in #product-runbook after the legal draft is done.
Caro (AE): Thanks team — I'll tell TitanCorp we can proceed with a canary dedicated carve-out + written timeline for hosted delivery in 4 months and that legal will send an amendment.
Ben (Eng): Quick note — if we see this pattern repeating with >3 customers, we should prioritize the host-level QoS work earlier.
Diego (CS): Agreed. We'll track in the renewal playbook whether we see churn risk tied to hosted SLAs.
Emma (VP Product): Good. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
